name: io.github.CoinVello/coinvello
title: CoinVello
description: Non-custodial crypto payments: checkout sessions, invoices, webhooks and test payments. No KYC.

environmentVariables.name: COINVELLO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: CoinVello API key. Use a cv_test_ key while developing; cv_live_ keys are refused unless COINVELLO_ALLOW_LIVE=1.

environmentVariables.name: COINVELLO_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Default https://api.coinvello.com/v1; http://localhost:4242/v1 for the local reference server.

environmentVariables.name: COINVELLO_ALLOW_LIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow a live key.
